text: Assumption: Callers receive neither an error message nor an error code nor an exception in the event of an error — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Callers receive neither an error message nor an error code nor an exception in the event of an error — is this correct?

assumption: Callers receive neither an error message nor an error code nor an exception in the event of an error.
rationale: According to SWS_CORE_06554, errors are silently ignored and the signature returns void without defined error channels.
